subject: The 2AM race that 847 users won
preview_text: While you slept, a surge of Predictify users cashed in on a 7-1 shot at Cheltenham. Here's how they saw it coming.
body_paragraphs: At 2:17 AM this morning, 847 Predictify users opened the app and saw a confidence score of 78% on a 7-1 horse at Cheltenham. They didn't hesitate. They placed their bets, went back to sleep, and woke up to a payout that most punters missed entirely.

That horse — 'Midnight Gambler' — had everything going for it: a trainer with a 34% win rate on soft ground, a jockey who'd won three of the last five at the track, and a hidden speed rating that only our AI caught. The crowd overlooked it because the form guide was cluttered. But the data was clear.

You already have access to the same analysis. The same 'Deep Racecard' feature that breaks down every variable — track conditions, weight advantages, distance proficiency — in seconds. It's sitting in your app right now, waiting for the next race. The only difference between you and those 847 users is that they tapped 'Open'.

Open Predictify now and check the confidence scores for today's 3:15 PM race at Ascot. One look at the data could be the difference between guessing and knowing.

P.S. The 3:15 race has a horse with a 62% confidence score. Most bettors will ignore it. Don't be most bettors.
